jobs.description: About the Project Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. We're looking for native-level speakers who can deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech — recordings that hold up whether you're reading a script or speaking spontaneously. Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. jobs.title: Hydrus - Session Director - Swiss German (CH) - V2
jobs.description: About the Project Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products — voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances. As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment — making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace. What You'll Do - Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation. - Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally. - Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed. - Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise. - Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes. - Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience. What We're Looking For Required - Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing. - Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction). - Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction. - Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels). - Comfortable improvising and adjusting scripted mat

jobs.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com . 📐 About the role Design engineers sit at the intersection of design and engineering. As a design engineer at WRITER, you'll own the Writer Design System (WDS) — how it's built, how it's maintained, and how both humans and AI agents use it to ship product. This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product. jobs.title: Senior Design Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Design Quality Engineer In Brief We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll safeguard product quality for an FDA-cleared, AI-driven clinical platform, from design controls while we build, to complaint investigation once it's live in hospitals, to the quality system and regulatory record that hold it all together. Who We Are Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data. We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes. About the Role Bayesian ships FDA-cleared, AI clinical decision support software directly into Epic and Oracle Health workflows at health systems across the country. Every release, every model update, and every clinician report that an alert didn't behave as expected runs through a quality and regulatory system that has to be as rigorous as the software itself. You will help drive that system. This role intentionally wears multiple hats. jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. jobs.title: Unreal Engine Motion Designer - Mob Control
jobs.description: About Voodoo Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 1000+ employees, 8 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publishers worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps like BeReal and Wizz. Team Our Growth team is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hypercasual, hybrid, 100% IAP). Working within our Creative Marketing team , you will be working on one of our top performing games, gathering +10M downloads per month, Mob Control . jobs.title: Solutions Designer
jobs.description: The Solutions Designer serves as the overall technical lead for assigned projects. This role is responsible for translating high-level architectural designs into detailed technical solutions, leading the technical implementation, and ensuring end-to-end system integration and delivery that meets business and operational requirements. Leads the creation of the Solution Plan (SP) based on the High-Level Solution (HLS) provided by the Solution Architect. Collaborates with the System Analyst to break down the HLS into actionable technical packages across applications and components. Works closely with the Project Manager (PM) and Business Analyst (BA) to refine and validate business and technical requirements. Reviews and validates the Detailed Functional Specification (DFS) with the System Analyst to ensure alignment with the planned solution. Coordinates with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Network Engineers, and Security teams to ensure holistic and secure end-to-end system design. Oversees the setup of testing and production environments in collaboration with System Administrators and Database Administrators through the System Analyst. Supports the Systems Analyst during the production handover process. Leads technical readiness activities, ensuring support teams are prepared to manage the system post-deployment. Oversees cutover planning and execution for deploying system enhancements into production. Provides technical leadership during the stabilization period after deployment, managing escalations and production issues. Partners with the PM and Service Management team to monitor system performance and assist with project closeout and knowledge transfer.
